newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: S&P says NZ MPS within expected policy framework.
newsitem.headline: S&P says NZ MPS within expected policy framework.

text.p: Ratings Agency Standard and Poor's said on Friday the Reserve Bank's June Monetary Policy Statement was consistent with its expectations of monetary policy management in New Zealand.

"Our current rating of New Zealand is based on a framework of expectations regarding the conduct of fiscal and monetary policy, and the Reserve Bank's actions are really a monetary policy management action that is consistent with, and is not outside, that framework of expectations we have," Graeme Lee, S&P managing director for Australia and New Zealand, told Reuters from Melbourne.
S&P's current sovereign credit rating for New Zealand is AA plus. -- Wellington Newsroom 64 4 473-4746
